cases.title: How-to: VPN

args.query: connect to VPN from home Brightmoor

result.title: Connecting to the VPN
result.body: Install Brightmoor Connect from the Software Center, sign in with your work account and approve the MFA prompt.

cases.answer:
Here’s how to connect to the VPN from home:

1. Open the **Software Center** and install **Brightmoor Connect**.  
2. Launch Brightmoor Connect and sign in with your work email.  
3. Approve the MFA prompt that appears.  

Once authenticated, you’ll be connected to the VPN.  

*Article used: “Connecting to the VPN”*

cases.title: How-to: printer

result.title: Adding a printer
result.body: Open Settings, Printers, Add. Floor printers are named BM-F<floor>, for example BM-F2.

cases.answer:
To add the printer on the 2nd floor, open **Settings → Printers → Add**.  
Floor printers are named **BM‑F<floor>** (e.g., **BM‑F2**).

cases.title: How-to: guest wifi

args.query: guest wifi how visitors get access

result.title: Guest wifi
result.body: Visitors use BM-Guest. Reception prints a code valid for one day.

cases.answer:
The guest Wi‑Fi is called **BM‑Guest**.  
Visitors receive a one‑day code printed by reception, which they can use to connect.

cases.title: How-to: signature

result.title: Email signature
result.body: In Outlook go to Settings, Mail, Compose and reply, and use the company template.

cases.answer:
Here’s how to update your email signature in Outlook:

1. Open Outlook and click **Settings** (gear icon).  
2. Go to **Mail** → **Compose and reply**.  
3. In the **Email signature** box, edit or create your signature.  
4. Click **Save**.

If you need the company template or further help, let me know.

cases.title: How-to: calendar

result.title: Sharing your calendar
result.body: In Outlook calendar choose Share, add your team and pick "Can view all details".

cases.answer:
Here’s how to share your calendar with your team:

1. Open Outlook and go to the Calendar view.  
2. Click **Share** (or right‑click the calendar and choose **Share Calendar**).  
3. Add your team members’ email addresses.  
4. Set the permission level to **Can view all details** (or another level that suits your needs).  
5. Click **Send**.

Your team will receive an invitation and can view your calendar.  

*Article used: “Sharing your calendar.”*

cases.title: How-to: MFA phone

args.query: move MFA app to new phone Brightmoor

result.title: Moving MFA to a new phone
result.body: Sign in at mysignins on the old phone, add the new phone, then remove the old one. Without the old phone, call the helpdesk.

cases.answer:
Here’s how to move your MFA app to a new phone:

1. Open the MFA app on your old phone and sign in at **mysignins**.  
2. Add your new phone as a device.  
3. Once the new phone is verified, remove the old phone from the MFA list.

If you can’t access the old phone, let me know and we’ll set up a temporary solution.
